title: Case Description — Digestive Organs
note: No Jundt form suggestion .txt exists yet. Draft based on meeting plan and existing blocks. Awaiting Jundt's version.

sections.title: Material
sections.compositionNote: Standard material block. No changes from block.

sections.title: Digestive symptoms
sections.compositionNote: All 17 digestive-specific symptoms. 3-state (unknown/no/yes) per Jundt's hematology form convention. Includes weightloss with kg, vomiting with hematemesis, abdominal pain with 6-quadrant grid + duration.

sections.title: Other systems
sections.compositionNote: D3/D7 gating: 'Other symptoms present?' reveals non-digestive symptoms. Includes respiratory (cough, chronic cough, breathlessness, hemoptysis, chest pain, smoker, expectoration), general (pain, swelling, night sweat, pallor, bleeding tendency, susceptibility), breast/gyn (nipple discharge, breast lump, retraction, pregnancy, vaginal bleeding/discharge), urology (dysuria, haematuria).

sections.title: Imaging
sections.compositionNote: General imaging only (X-ray, US, CT, MRI, PET/CT). No jaw or breast specials — not relevant for digestive. Upload attachments on Yes.

designDecisions.reason: Consistent with hematology form convention per Jundt's request.

designDecisions.decision: Dedup: digestive block already contains weightloss, fever, jaundice, easybruising
designDecisions.reason: These items appear in both symptoms.digestive and symptoms master. Digestive variant wins (richer — includes weightloss.kg).
